name: XRP Grid Bot — Long Strategy
author: 3Commas
license: unknown (no license header; TradingView House Rules open-source script)
indicators: arithmetic/geometric grid between low and high price, N levels (e.g. 23), investment 10000 USDT
entry_long: buy each grid level crossed down; sell one level up
exit: sell at next grid level; flat at range break
implementation_notes: One of ~10 near-identical 3Commas coin-specific grid scripts (XRP,FIL,XLM,BTC,TWT,ENA,NOT,EURUSD,TRX) differing only in hard-coded range/levels (merged, see DEDUPE_NOTES). Pine strategy() script: backtest results depend on TradingView broker emulator (fills, slippage) - not reproducible 1:1. Retrieved source via pine-facade API; my extraction is a lossy summary, read the source before coding.
